systems.system: shared underground fibre ducts and poles, Greater Kampala Metropolitan Area
systems.country_label: reorganization of utility infrastructure in the GKMA
systems.platform: internet service providers' overhead fibre moved to shared poles and underground ducts along KCCA roads
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, with the Uganda Communications Commission, licensed internet service providers and the Uganda Electricity Distribution Company
systems.tiers: Greater Kampala; pilot Corridor 1 on three roads in Makindye, Central and Nakawa divisions, works from the end of September 2025

note: The tidying of commercial operators' fibre along Kampala's roads; the divisions are where the roads lie, and no local government office is said to be connected.
